newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to raise telephone rates by April - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to raise telephone rates by April - paper.

text.p: Brazil is likely to authorise an increase in telephone rates by late April in a prior step to the privatization of federal Telebras system, Folha de Sao Paulo daily said.
According to a study by Telebras, local calls need to rise by 200 percent to compensate a reduction in rates for long-distance calls, the newspaper said.
The tariff rebalancing is aimed at eliminating the so-called crossed subsidies, Folha said.
The newspaper said Communications Minister Sergio Motta did not confirm the rate hike in April, but acknowledged that there will be a rate restructuring before Telebras is privatized.
The last tariff adjustment occurred in November 1995.
